messages:
Maya: FYI the QBR slide scaffold is up in the drive: <https://drive.google.com/.../qbr-scaffold>. Need exec alignment + slide owners by EOD Fri. TL;DR: account health, onboarding status, renewal risks, enablement asks, feedback log.

Jonas: On the "renewal risks" slide — can we include a churn signal heatmap? I can pull numbers and a short risk scoring column.

Priya: I can own onboarding status + adoption metrics. Which date range?

Maya: Priya — last 90 days. Use 'activated users' + 'feature adoption rate' (weekly active / MAU). Please include early dropoff funnel.

Ava: I'll take the exec-ask slide. @Maya can you share 3 bullets we want exec to sign off on?

Maya: Sure:
1) Approve 6-week Dedicated pilot commitment for Meridian-ish accounts
2) Prioritize SSO + compliance fixes (P0) in Q3 roadmap
3) Approve margin & renewal discount guardrails for renewals under negotiation

Tom: Action items: Jonas -> renewal risk table by Thu COB; Priya -> onboarding slide by Fri 10:00; Ava -> draft exec ask slide by Fri 12:00. I'll compile and run deck pass on Mon.

Jonas: Got it. Uploaded raw table here: `s3://r-inference/qbr/renewal_risks.csv` — I'll add scoring notes in the sheet.

Maya: Also need an enablement blurb and metric for the 'enablement -> time-to-first-success' slide. Rachel from SE saw improvement after the onboarding sprint. @Rachel can you confirm a stat we can quote?

Rachel: Confirming — observed a 28–32% reduction in avg time-to-first-success for customers who completed the sprint. I'll drop a 1-paragraph blurb + one customer quote (paraphrased) in the doc.

Priya: Where's the canonical feedback board for customer quotes from EBRs?

Maya: Use the 'Feedback' tab in the QBR drive (sheet). I'll export top quotes to slide notes. If you have strong quotes, paste them here.

Ava: Pasting draft (anonymized): "Large fintech customer: Redwood reduced latency and freed up eng cycles" — okay to paraphrase?

Maya: Yes, anonymize per policy (use 'Large fintech customer'). No legal signoff needed for paraphrased quote but avoid exact PII.

calendar-bot: Event created — QBR Dry Run • Tue 09:00 — Invited: Maya, Jonas, Priya, Ava, Tom

Jonas: Also propose adding a one-slide ops contingency plan (fallback models + thresholds for auto-failover). I'll draft the slide.

Maya: Good idea. Put it under 'Reliability & Fallbacks' and include thresholds we observe in the console.

Priya: Added trends chart + adoption notes to the drive (link: <https://drive.google.com/.../qbr/onboarding-chart>). Please review.

Maya: :thumbsup: Quick in-thread checklist:
- [x] Slide scaffold up
- [ ] Owners assigned (update this thread when done)
- [ ] Renewal table (Jonas)
- [ ] Exec bullets (Ava)
- [ ] Feedback quotes (Rachel/Ava)
- [ ] Dry-run attendance

I'll update status tomorrow AM.

Ava: Will mark mine when draft is ready. Thanks!
